## About this round

SCF #44 Build award (Integration track) for 'Scaling Azza Across Africa': WhatsApp-based AI agent for buying, selling and transferring crypto and local currency (NGN, GHS, KES). Award listed in the SCF #44 round recap published 24 Jul 2026 (round closed for submissions 14 Jun 2026); Stellar Nigeria / Dealroom / Technext publicised the Nigerian winners on 19 Aug 2026. XLM-denominated award, USD value as stated by SCF.
